notes:
Your scene in your Minecraft world, as you build it. Turn on File › Live Link to Minecraft and the scene shows see-through in the world; B puts it where you stand, G moves it, N places it as real blocks, M takes it back, Enter keeps it. It needs the BlocMod Link mod (Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric and Fabric API, single player): File › Install BlocMod Link… puts it in for you.

- File › Import Video…: a clip as blocks, played in the view, in Minecraft by a data pack, or through the Live Link.
- File › Import Model…: glTF, OBJ, PLY and STL models as blocks, matched to their colours and textures.
- Objects panel: Sort Alphabetically and a search field.
- Properties: drag the icons into an order of your own.
- The Material Browser's height can be dragged.
- Displace has an Offset that slides its noise, and no longer leaves straight lines on flat ground.
- The Shortcuts card fits the window and lists every key.
- Box, lasso and circle select take guides and measurements; the lasso and the circle pick an FFD cage's points.
- Fixes: pale specks along block edges, the Add Modifier menu near the foot of the window, and the Add Structure card.

Found a bug? Post it in #bug-reports, or write to support@blocmod.app.
